children: Abu Dhabi-based Creative Investments has secured $20 million, ahead of plans to make acquisitions in the heritage food and hospitality sectors.

The investment firm, which plans to list its shares in a few years, intends to raise up to $50 million. It was founded by Egyptian entrepreneur Mohamed Talaat Khalifa, in partnership with Onsi Sawiris, Ali Abubakr and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Agency.

The company, which also has presence in Cairo and Milan, makes controlling acquisitions in various sectors, including food and culinary experiences, hospitality, fashion and retail, and lifestyle and entertainment.

Its plans include a potential acquisition in the heritage food industry and evaluating assets for its proprietary boutique hotel concept, Casa Leo. It also has plans to list on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange, Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) or London Stock Exchange within five to seven years.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Abu Dhabi’s Creative Investments secures $20mln to fund acquisitions
